retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, metallic gold bat silhouette encased in an oval frame with sharp beveled edges and airbrushed highlights against a deep black background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A stylized black bat silhouette centered within a golden-yellow oval. The emblem features a heavy 3D beveled effect with chrome-like metallic reflections, sharp specular highlights (glints), and a smooth airbrushed gradient transition from deep amber to bright yellow.
coreVisualRelationships: Black silhouette nested within a gold oval
Beveled metallic edges defining the interior and exterior shapes
Specular glints positioned at sharp vertices
High-contrast relationship between the dark background and the luminous gold
coreInvariants: Symmetrical bat silhouette with pointed ears and scalloped wings
Metallic gold/amber color palette with chrome highlights

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The emblem is centrally positioned, filling approximately 80% of the frame horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central black bat silhouette acts as the primary negative space anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the circular curve of the oval frame before settling on the sharp points of the bat's wings and ears.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black surrounds the oval and forms the central bat shape, creating a figure-ground reversal effect.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black background and central silhouette
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Golden-yellow to amber gradients for the oval field
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white and silver for metallic glints and beveled edges
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark core and the luminous, highly saturated gold frame.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast image of a metallic gold oval with a black bat silhouette in the center. Apply a heavy 3D bevel to the edges of the gold area. Use airbrushed gradients from amber to yellow and add sharp white star-shaped glints on the corners.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: No text required; if adding a title, use a bold, wide sans-serif with metallic texture to match the emblem.

verificationChecks: Is the bat silhouette perfectly symmetrical?
Are the metallic glints placed on the sharpest points?

postGenerationChecks: Check for symmetry in the bat silhouette
Ensure the bevel effect looks three-dimensional
Verify the presence of specular highlights
Confirm the background is solid black
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a [Subject Silhouette] and place it inside a [Metallic Color] [Geometric Shape] with [Beveled Chrome Edges] and [Airbrushed Highlights] against a [Solid Dark Background].
